title: Veratramine alleviates asthmatic airway remodelling via the PKM2/CREB1 lactylation/SMAD7 axis.
authors: Feng, Rixin; Bai, Qiaoyun; Ding, Ningpo; You, Fujia; Wang, Chongyang; Jin, Guangyu; Song, Yilan; Yan, Guanghai
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Veratramine通过PKM2/CREB1乳酸化/SMAD7轴缓解哮喘气道重塑，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是代谢-表观遗传调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Veratramine is a natural steroidal alkaloid derived from plants of the genus Veratrum that exhibits anti-inflammatory potential. However, its pharmacological mechanisms and direct molecular targets in asthmatic airway remodelling remain unclear, particularly regarding its role in regulating metabolism-epigenetic crosstalk within the airway microenvironment. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to determine whether Veratramine downregulates pyruvate kinase M2 (PKM2) to suppress lactate accumulation, thereby inhibiting cAMP response element-binding protein 1 (CREB1) lactylation, restoring SMAD family member 7 (SMAD7) expression, and ultimately reversing transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta)-driven airway remodelling. METHODS: A house dust mite (HDM)-induced murine asthma model was established to assess Veratramine efficacy. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) confirmed its interaction with PKM2. Mass spectrometry, CUT&Tag sequencing, site-directed mutagenesis (K122R/Q), and adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated in vivo gene delivery were used to delineate the signalling axis. RESULTS: Veratramine dose-dependently attenuated HDM-induced airway inflammation, goblet cell metaplasia, and subepithelial collagen deposition. It was shown to bind to and downregulate PKM2, thereby reducing pulmonary lactate accumulation. Mechanistically, HDM induced CREB1 lactylation at K122, limiting its conformational flexibility and promoting repression of the antifibrotic gene SMAD7, leading to TGF-beta pathway activation and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). Inhibition of K122 lactylation or restoration of SMAD7 effectively reversed airway remodelling. CONCLUSION: This study identifies a novel "PKM2-lactate-CREB1 lactylation-SMAD7" axis driving airway remodelling in asthma. Veratramine acts as a PKM2 modulator, restoring SMAD7-mediated negative feedback via metabolic reprogramming, and represents a promising lead for anti-remodelling therapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：藜芦胺（Veratramine）是一种来源于藜芦属（Veratrum）植物的天然甾体生物碱，具有抗炎潜力。然而，其在哮喘气道重塑中的药理学机制和直接分子靶点仍不清楚，尤其是在调节气道微环境中代谢-表观遗传串扰方面的作用。目的：本研究旨在确定藜芦胺是否通过下调丙酮酸激酶M2（PKM2）抑制乳酸积累，从而抑制cAMP反应元件结合蛋白1（CREB1）的乳酰化，恢复SMAD家族成员7（SMAD7）的表达，并最终逆转转化生长因子-β（TGF-beta）驱动的气道重塑。方法：建立屋尘螨（HDM）诱导的小鼠哮喘模型以评估藜芦胺的疗效。分子对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）确认了其与PKM2的相互作用。质谱分析、CUT&Tag测序、定点突变（K122R/Q）和腺相关病毒（AAV）介导的体内基因递送用于描绘信号轴。结果：藜芦胺剂量依赖性地减轻了HDM诱导的气道炎症、杯状细胞化生和上皮下胶原沉积。它被证明能结合并下调PKM2，从而减少肺部乳酸积累。机制上，HDM诱导CREB1在K122位点的乳酰化，限制其构象灵活性并促进抗纤维化基因SMAD7的抑制，导致TGF-beta通路激活和上皮-间质转化（EMT）。抑制K122乳酰化或恢复SMAD7可有效逆转气道重塑。结论：本研究识别了一条新的“PKM2-乳酸-CREB1乳酰化-SMAD7”轴，驱动哮喘中的气道重塑。藜芦胺作为PKM2调节剂，通过代谢重编程恢复SMAD7介导的负反馈，代表了抗重塑治疗的一个有前景的先导化合物。
